items.title: Ethereum treasury firm BTCS sold ether at a loss to keep $64 million Aave loan healthy
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed company has 46,676 ETH backing its borrowings, and the loan could become eligible for liquidation if ether slides to around $1,700.

items.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
items.summary: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday.

items.title: Ethereum researchers drop faster blocks to race toward quantum defenses in 2027
items.summary: Ethlabs wants quantum-resistant accounts targeted for next year, even if wallet holders still have to switch signing methods themselves.

items.title: ETFs de Ether perdem força antes de teste do suporte em US$ 2.540
items.summary: Ethereum acumula alta de 7,90% em sete dias, mas vê entradas em ETFs desacelerarem e precisa defender suporte entre US$ 2.530 e US$ 2.540.
